procedures.name: RADAR 5S
procedures.description: Climb HDG 139°, expect radar vector to airway. Climb HDG 138°, expect radar vector to airway. proceed as follows. proceed direct to HP100, HP120, BELTU to BINIL for G597 as appropriate. proceed as described above prior to reaching NCN D20 or R 235 SEL or WNG D16 or SOT D19 due to airspace.

procedures.name: RADAR 3A
procedures.description: Climb on RWY HDG until NCN D6. turn left HDG 270° expect radar vector to airway. proceed  as follows. proceed direct to YD100 then SEL for G597  - fly south to join G597 to NOPIK  - fly south to YD100, YD130 and OSPOT for A582  - fly south to YD100, YD130, YD160, YD190 and BOPTA for BEDES via Z51.
restrictions: 0(SEL D29.1 or WNG D9.6 or SOT D43),
Pilot shall remain within NCN D16 (SEL D40 or 17 NM from Airport as appropriate) during on HDG 270°.
